models_evaluated: AI pulmonary nodule detection algorithm (trained on 6-mm to 30-mm nodules)

links.outcome: Effect of background AI-NLP quality assurance on radiologist workflow and follow-up delays
links.effect: Of 19,246 CTs, 50 (0.26%) went to secondary review; 34 of 50 (68%) led to addenda; median time to addendum was 11 hours; no workflow disruption reported.
links.quote: This was achieved without disrupting in-shift radiologist workflow or causing significant delays in patient follow for the diagnosed pulmonary nodule.

unlisted_practices: Background AI plus NLP discrepancy check that flags missed incidental findings in radiology reports for secondary radiologist review and addenda, run outside the normal reading workflow

screen.reason: Evaluates the prospective implementation of a background AI-NLP quality assurance discrepancy detection and secondary review system to safeguard against missed pulmonary nodules without disrupting radiologist workflow.

primary.practice: AI-NLP background quality assurance and secondary review workflow
